compatible.executable_observation: The Flask static-file endpoint still delegates the caller-supplied relative path to send_from_directory_gzip_compressed, whose final file response is rooted by Flask send_from_directory.

provisional_focal_property: For the web static-file endpoint, caller-controlled request path input cannot select a filesystem response target outside the packaged aim/web/ui/build directory.

source.executable_observation: The source Flask static-file endpoint delegates the caller-supplied relative path to Flask send_from_directory with a separately constructed packaged UI root.
source.subject: Move the Flask server to main repo to support 'docker'less UI (#455)
